concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 2 – Core Implementation → I04 Inconsistency logic
concerns.text: FR‑012 (baseline handling) is not referenced anywhere in the plan. The inconsistency‑logic module description mentions absolute p‑value and effect‑size checks but omits the required heuristic of using the average of the two variant rates when a baseline conversion rate is missing.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 3 – Validation & Testing → V02 Extraction accuracy evaluation
concerns.text: SC‑001 (extraction accuracy ≥ 95 % on the real‑world validation set) is absent. The plan only specifies precision ≥ 85 % and recall ≥ 75 % (SC‑031b) and does not include a separate 95 % field‑level accuracy metric.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 2 – Core Implementation → I05 Prevalence estimation
concerns.text: SC‑014 (binomial test output must be rounded to three decimals, Wilson CI width ≤ 0.10, and significance flagged when p ≤ 0.05) is not mentioned. The plan describes performing the binomial test and Wilson CI but does not state the rounding or CI‑width constraints.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 2 – Core Implementation → I05 Prevalence estimation
concerns.text: SC‑015 (sensitivity analysis variation must be < 0.02 across baseline proportions 0.02–0.10) is missing. The plan includes a sensitivity sweep but does not specify the acceptable maximum variation.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 4 – CI & Documentation → C04 Quickstart verification
concerns.text: SC‑028 (quickstart guide must be verified by at least three independent novice users completing the audit on 30 URLs within 30 minutes) is not covered. The plan only checks that the quickstart run finishes within 30 minutes on the CI runner, without the user‑study component.
